points.text: M1: first curly arrow from within hexagon to N of the $\text{NO}_2^+$
M3: second curly arrow from C–H bond into the ring AND $\text{H}^+$ formed / lost
M1: benzoic acid: 3-nitrobenzoic acid with $\text{COOH}$ group and $\text{NO}_2$ group in meta position
M2: phenol: 2-nitrophenol with $\text{OH}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ ortho OR 4-nitrophenol with $\text{HO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$ para

M2 / M3: phenol: lone pair / p-orbital on oxygen delocalises into the ring / overlaps with $\pi$-delocalised ring; accepts / attracts / polarises $\text{NO}_2^+$ / electrophiles better; benzoic acid: $\text{COOH}$ / C=O is an electron-withdrawing / positive inductive effect
points.guidance: two for one mark, three for two marks

points.text: M4: (phenol-oxygen) increases electron density in the ring (as compared to benzene as a result of the $\text{OH}$ group) OR (benzoic acid–$\text{COOH}$) decreases electron density in the ring (as compared to benzene as a result of the $\text{COOH}$ group)
X: $\text{H}_2\text{N}$–[biphenyl]–$\text{NH}_2$ 4,4'-diaminobiphenyl with $\text{NH}_2$ groups para to central bond
Z: $\text{N}\equiv\text{N}^+$–[biphenyl]–$\text{N}^+\equiv\text{N}$ bis-diazonium salt with $\text{N}\equiv\text{N}^+$ groups para to central bond
Y: naphthalene derivative with $\text{NH}_2$ and $\text{SO}_3^-\text{Na}^+$ groups
